item.title: How Product Management Can Help Teams Tackle Tech Debt (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep53 - Live!) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: In this special live on LinkedIn Scaling Tech Podcast event, we are going to discuss how Product Management and tech teams can work together to tackle Tech Debt! Our guests will be product management expert Kent J. McDonald and tech debt author and engineering expert Lou Franco, and the discussion will be moderated by Scaling Tech Podcast host Arin Sime.

item.title: The Right Way to Encourage AI in Tech Interviews with Anna J McDougall (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep54 - Live!) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: Our Scaling Tech Podcast guest, Anna J McDougall, shares new method for structuring multi-stage technical interviews that closely mirror real-world scenarios, balancing realistic expectations, useful insights, and equitable testing conditions. This includes live pair programming with the freedom to use tools like Google, GPT, Copilot, or Cursor—evaluating how they use AI as part of a modern developer's toolbox.

item.title: Managing Deployments and DevOps at Scale with Tom Elliott (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep55 - Live!) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 55 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, DevOps veteran Tom Elliott shares lessons from scaling CI/CD for 200+ engineers at Yext. We dive into deployment pitfalls, internal tooling gone wrong, and what inspired his new venture, Ocuroot.

item.title: Emerging Tech Markets in Colombia: Cali (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep56) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 56 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, host Arin Sime is joined by Valery Sanclemente of Invest Pacific for a deep dive into what makes Cali, Colombia, an emerging tech hub and an attractive location for your BPO, KPO, or tech team.

item.title: Leveraging Legacy Data to Grow Your Business (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep57) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 57 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, host Arin Sime is joined by Ritavan, author of Data Impact: How Legacy Businesses Save, Leverage, Align, Simplify, Optimize, and Grow.

item.title: Emerging Tech Markets in Colombia: Barranquilla (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep58) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: When you think of Colombia’s Caribbean coast, tech might not be the first thing that comes to mind. Yet Barranquilla is steadily emerging as a strategic hub for innovation, leveraging its central location, growing talent base, and strong entrepreneurial energy. In this episode, we visit Tech Caribe, the region’s flagship technology conference, to explore how […]

item.title: The Evolution of DevOps: Automation, Scale, and the AI Frontier (Scaling Tech Podcast Ep59 - Live!) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: In this live episode of the Scaling Tech Podcast, we welcome Mihir Vora, Senior Distinguished Engineer at Capital One, to explore how DevOps has evolved, from early automation and cloud migrations to the emerging influence of AI on developer productivity. We discuss what it takes to balance safety with speed, why “intent-based engineering” could redefine how we build software, and how AI might soon transform the DevOps lifecycle.

item.title: Evidence-Driven Engineering with David Bland (Scaling Tech Podcast Episode 60 - Live!) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 60 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, host Arin Sime welcomes David Bland to discuss how can engineering teams use an evidence driven approach to support the business in building truly valuable applications.

item.title: AI Engineering in Mexico - Part 1 (Scaling Tech Podcast Episode 61) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 61 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, host Arin Sime explores the landscape of AI engineering and adoption in Mexico, recording from Mexico City. He speaks with founders, engineers, and researchers about building real AI applications and the lessons learned in reshaping engineering teams.

item.title: AI Engineering in Mexico - Part 2 (Scaling Tech Podcast Episode 62) - ScalingTechPod
item.description: On Episode 62 of the Scaling Tech Podcast, our second in a series recorded in Mexico, host Arin Sime speaks with founders, engineers, and researchers in Mexico about building real AI applications and the lessons learned in reshaping engineering teams.
